steps.content: A frail silhouette emerges at the corridor's end.
She looks as if she has clawed her way out of the deepest catastrophe zone. Viscous black contamination clings to her, invading every surface of her skin and clothes.
She clutches jagged contamination crystals to her chest. They have pierced straight through her flesh—hands, arms, shoulders—yet she will not let go, staggering forward step by labored step.
Her movement is so slow that it feels intentional, almost ceremonial.
Not a soul moves. A silence colder than the grave descends, every witness paralyzed by the sight of her and the sinister glow she carries.
Who is she?
What is she carrying?
A weapon of mass destruction... or a treasure beyond value?

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: The Campbell girl...? How is this possible?!
Saina recognizes the girl. She and Helga had scoured the edges of the catastrophe tear zone for Hypatia, finally concluding she was lost. Yet here she stands, covered in contamination...
Saina struggles upright and steps forward, only to be driven back by the palpable force of contamination emanating from Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: What are you....?!
Hypatia does not respond. Her eyes are hollow, unseeing. She has no strength left to fight the contamination, no voice left to warn or explain.
Still, she walks. One laborious step at a time.
As she passes by, Saina sees it: nestled within the corrupted mass in the young girl's hands, beautiful crystalline blue fragments pulse with a faint, ethereal light.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: ...She's holding... Hypercubes?!

A wave of shocked whispers sweeps through the Fraser nobility. Marcus stares at Margaret, stunned, but she merely fans herself, her smile unchanged, as if all of this is proceeding exactly as she intended.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Under the torture of catastrophes, what the farland people want most is simply to "survive." And now, Hypatia has brought them that hope.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: How unfortunate, Senator Marcus, that it was Hypatia Campbell—whom you dismissed—who achieved this miracle...

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: ...So this was your game all along. Everything from the very beginning, all of it for this!!
The BR-005 vein, missing since the Ash Campaign... if it had been found by this DisCity woman...!
Watching the farlanders display expressions of fanatical devotion, almost all Fraser leaders share the same thought—
The DisCity woman's schemes must end here!

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Guards! Stop Hypatia Campbell! Do not let her advance! Seize what she carries! Kill her if you must!
Marcus lurches to his feet and smashes the call button with furious desperation, bellowing his command.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Do not let her give it to Kervoz! We can't let the Disian have it! Kill her!!
[Scene Change: Luminaris Society]

Inside the Luminaris Society laboratory, Marcus's frantic voice crackles through the communicator. A woman in a white lab coat slowly looks up, her eyes on the live feed of the chaos, and speaks to the microphone with perfect calm.
Then, time to deploy the weapon of the "Sophos."
[Sky Tower Venue]

steps.speaker: Monstrous Bird
steps.content: HISSSS—

Inside the Sky Tower venue, a low, resonant hum suddenly rises from deep beneath, vibrating through the floor. Before anyone can react, an immense cyan bird appears behind the structure, wings spread wide enough to blot out the sun. A vast, suffocating shadow falls over the gathered crowd.

Its feathers gleam with an artificial, gem-like luster, and its form—though elegant in shape—radiates a profound wrongness. Slowly, its eyeless face rotates at the tower's apex, then locks onto its target with unnerving, mechanical precision.

steps.speaker: Monstrous Bird
steps.content: HISSSS—
Another piercing shriek tears through the air as the giant bird plummets, targeting Hypatia at the crowd's center!
Sensing the danger, the Aurum Secretum within her body surges into action, creating a resonating defensive barrier around her.
But her resistance proves far too weak. The artificial bird barely slows before driving onward.
BWAK!
The giant bird lets out a piercing shriek as the powerful impact from a sniper round staggers its massive form.
BWAK!
A second shot tears through its wing, spraying not blood but a shower of glimmering, Aurum Secretum-like crystals.
BWAK!

The third shot strikes the giant bird's face with precise force. Though it doesn't fully penetrate, the impact fractures the surface like glass. With a shriek of agony, the creature staggers back, its wings now useless and grounded.
Heads snap toward the gunfire. Helga is braced on the crumbling platform, fighting Margaret's psychic pressure just to keep her rifle steady.
The wind tears at her silver hair as she stands amid the gunsmoke, her sharp gaze sweeping across every farlander below.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: People of the farlands! Are you really so helpless that you need a little girl to risk her life for you?

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Go fight it!
Fraser's trying to steal the Hypercubes! "Fraser wants her dead!" "Protect her! Protect her!!"

steps.speaker: Farland Refugee
steps.content: If Fraser doesn't want her, then the farlands will!
Shouts rise from the crowd. Even under Margaret's psychic hold, the people of the farlands surge forward, ignoring contamination to shield Hypatia with their bodies.
She's brought Hypercube. It's Hypercube!!

Battered and bloody, the Aurum Secretum Warrior plants herself before Hypatia. Aurum Secretum markings now cover her skin like living scripture, her burning gaze fixed on the approaching guards. She is now a wrathful deity ready to break upon them.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: You bastards!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: If you want to hurt her... you go through me first!

Some hurl stones with desperate strength, others raise broken Aurum prosthetics as shields, and the boldest charge the giant bird to disrupt its path. Their attacks scarcely mark its hardened feathers, yet not a single person flinches.
Margaret watches, a faint smile touching her lips. With a soft snap, she closes her fan and releases the psychic hold over the crowd.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: ...That's more like it.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: If one must fight, let it be for a cause like this.
